title: Roster import and staff whitelist are coordinator/admin only
decision: Only coordinators and admins may import student roster CSVs and manage the staff whitelist. Supervisors have neither permission.
reason: Found after prompt 00-03: the supervisor nav showed Roster Import because FR-01.4 and the UI skill allowed it.
supersedes: FR-01.4: Supervisors and Coordinators can bulk-import student rosters
